messages:
amira: @channel Heads-up: SDK v4.1 ships next week. Two coordinated changes: client-side telemetry becomes opt-in by default, and the legacy ~/.redwood/runtime-flags.json is deprecated in favor of a per-process --runtime-config v2. Migration guide: https://go.redwood/docs/sdk-v4-1-migration :loudspeaker:
noah: Customer impact? will hosted API users break?
jen: Most customers unaffected. Break only if you relied on the legacy flags file or implicit client telemetry. Hosted server telemetry unchanged. We include a 30-day grace period where the SDK warns but still reads the legacy file; after that it will ignore it.
amira: Timeline: rc out tomorrow, GA in 7 days, 30-day compatibility window begins at GA. During the window we print deprecation warnings to stderr and link the migration docs.
jen: Migration snippets will be in the PR. Node opt-in example: const {Client} = require('@redwood/sdk'); const c = new Client({telemetry:{enabled:true}}); Python opt-in via REDWOOD_SDK_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN=true. New runtime-config CLI: --runtime-config='{"enable_fast_kv":true}'.
ops: Dedicated/Private clusters that provisioned ~/.redwood/runtime-flags.json via config management must switch to --runtime-config or set REDWOOD_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH to a mounted file. Management console provides a transformer to convert common keys.
docs-bot: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212 includes migration checklist, helm snippets, and mobile guidance. Please review.
luis: Requesting comms package: exec blurb, CSM FAQ, and mobile-howto.
amira: Comms plan: day 0 announce here + #customers; day 2 targeted email to Dedicated/Private; day 7 GA + console banner; day 14 reminder and migration metrics for opted-in telemetry. I'll post the CSM FAQ by EOD.
dev-bot: Release artifact: v4.1.0-rc3 pushed (sha a1b2c3d4). Integration tests started.
noah: DevEx: make opt-in examples prominent in quickstarts and sdk init templates.
jen: Will add mobile snippets and sample helm manifests to the docs PR.
amira: Thanks—if the compatibility job flags regressions, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
